exposure: Return to work prior to three months
return to work prior to three months
cohort: 729 women aged ≥ 18 years, diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) in 2010 and registered with the National Diabetes Services Scheme in Australia
finding: Early cessation of breastfeeding in women with recent GDM was associated with breastfeeding problems at home, return to work before three months, inadequate breastfeeding support, caesarean delivery, lower socioeconomic status, and higher BMI, while being married or in a de facto relationship was protective.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with early cessation of breastfeeding in women with recent GDM.
